title: Steve bots (BlockFront)
description: This resource pack changes skins of all bots to Steve (Unofficial resource pack for BlockFront)
body:
## BlockFront but Steve
This resource pack changes skins of all bots to Steve (Unofficial resource pack for [BlockFront](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockfront)).

![Steve](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/292995a21c275920a6e60f7ae51f8b51786814ed.png)
Oh damn Steve
## Installation
1. Download;
2. Drop to `.minecraft/resourcepacks`;
3. Steve.
4. Steve.
